source.citation: Miron, G. D., Kulik, D. A., Yan, Y., Tits, J., & Lothenbach, B. (2022). Extensions of CASH+ thermodynamic solid solution model for the uptake of alkali metals and alkaline earth metals in C-S-H. Cement and Concrete Research 152, 106667.
source.location: Section 2, Tables A1 (pp. 22-23) and A3 (p. 24); Supplementary data, the discretized CASH+NK model (spreadsheet mmc2)

transcription.from: the published article (PDF), Tables A1 and A3 read on the rendered page and compared with the text layer; the discretized model read from the supplementary spreadsheet, whose numbers are copied as stored
transcription.note: The CASH+NK model: the core model of Kulik et al. (2022) with sodium and potassium on the interlayer-cation site, as N = NaHOH+ and K = KHOH+. With the three species of the bridging-tetrahedron site (S, v, C) and the four of the interlayer site (v, C, N, K), the twelve end-members are every compound of the two sites. Only what this paper adds is transcribed: the six alkali end-members (Table A1) and the interaction parameters of the interlayer site with the alkalis (Table A3); the core end-members and the core interactions are those of Kulik2022, which Tables A1 and A3 reprint.

cashplus_nk_end_members.location: Table A1, the sublattice formulas summed (DU = (CaSiO3)2H2O, IW = H2O)

alkali_standard_properties.location: Table A1 (p. 22); G fitted, S and Cp from VBT, V from the density

cashplus_nk_interactions.location: Table A3 (p. 24); the four core parameters are those of Kulik2022, which the table reprints

dsp_pseudocompounds.location: Supplementary data (spreadsheet mmc2), sheet 'CASH+NK DSP model': the discretized model, one pseudocompound per row, with its dissolution reaction at 25 C

cashplus_full_end_members.location: Table A1, the sublattice formulas summed (DU = (CaSiO3)2H2O, IW = H2O)

extension_standard_properties.location: Table A1 (pp. 22-23); G fitted, S and Cp from VBT, V from the density

cashplus_full_interactions.location: Table A3 (p. 24): each printed parameter is shared by the pairs it lists (W_IC-v[Li, N, K, Rb, Cs] is the value of the five pairs v-Li to v-Cs); the four core parameters are those of Kulik2022

aqueous_species.location: Table A1 (p. 23), aqueous species derived in this study (CaSiO3@ is the core model's, Kulik2022)

dissolution_log_K.location: Table A2 (pp. 23-24), log10 K at 25 C of the dissolution of each end-member into Ca+2, SiO2@, H2O and its interlayer cation, and of Ca(OH)2@ into Ca+2 and H2O (the column headed Delta_r G holds Delta_r H, and is not transcribed)

TSvh_H.location: Table A1 (p. 23), core end-member TSvh reprinted from Kulik2022
TSvh_H.description: Standard enthalpy of formation of TSvh at 25 C, as this paper reprints it; Table 8 of Kulik2022 prints -5032.03, which does not agree with its G and S.

notes: The spreadsheet names each pseudocompound by its Ca/Si and alkali/Si ratios (CSH073+N0064: Ca/Si 0.73, Na/Si 0.0064); its formula fixes the site fractions of the model uniquely, so the Gibbs energy of the model at that composition can be compared with the one the reaction gives.
Table A2 gives dissolution reactions of the end-members; it is not transcribed (Table A1 holds the standard properties they are computed from).
The interaction parameters of Table A3 with Li, Rb, Cs and the alkaline earths, and their end-members, are not transcribed: the CASH+NK model needs sodium and potassium only.
The core end-members reprinted in Table A1 carry their S, Cp and V rounded to integers; those of Kulik2022 (Table 4, one decimal) are the ones used.

The extension to Li, Rb, Cs, Mg, Sr, Ba and Ra (Tables A1 and A3) is transcribed with its 21 end-members, the 55 interaction parameters of the interlayer site and the master species; the log K of Table A2 are recomputed from the G of Table A1 and the master species to 0.01, which checks the transcription of each end-member.

Ca(OH)2@ is an aqueous species these authors derived and kept when fitting the extension (Section 3.2: 'With the exception of Ca(OH)2 0, these neutral complexes were finally excluded'); the core model of Kulik2022 was fitted without it.
